_inputs: Paths are relative to the directory the script runs in; the README animation was made in ~/local/mallard-runs/hero3 (outside the repository): double_mach = the double Mach example's snapshots at Nx = 1920, Ny = 480; detonation_2d = examples/detonation_2d's snapshots; tgv_frames and sphere_frames = the 3D views cropped from the 1920x1080 animations of tools/animate_taylor_green.py --full-box (examples/taylor_green_3d/input_periodic.toml, Nx = 128; frames resampled to uniform t) and tools/animate_sphere_re300.py (examples/sphere_re300, U and Q written every 0.1 D / U over t U / D = 135-150), one PNG per frame with a times.txt; tgv_eps.csv and tgv_eps_dns.csv = -dE/dt of that run's integrals.csv and of the 512^3 spectral DNS, CSV with columns t,y. To use another rendering of a 3D case, replace its frames directory.
